name: Profession Of Affection
source:
Despite some money troubles, Eric had learned to manage his life, finding friendship, love, and a whole lot more in his life... But that all changes when one day he wakes up to find things are just a little bit... different.

[From [url=https://dead-end-draws.itch.io/profession-of-affection-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尽管遇到了一些金钱问题，埃里克还是学会了管理自己的生活，在生活中寻找友谊、爱情以及更多的东西……但是当有一天他醒来发现事情有点……不同时，一切都改变了。
